service.name: loans
service.title: Loans
service.description: Loan quoting, disclosure, booking, disbursement, installment billing and principal collection on OFBiz accounting.

entities.name: Loan
entities.title: A booked loan, its terms, its current schedule and its servicing state

entities.name: LoanScheduleLine
entities.title: The lines of a loan's current schedule (disbursement, down payment, installments)

entities.name: LoanServicingLine
entities.title: The servicing state of each line to bill (its invoice and the deposit that collected its principal)

entities.name: LoanProduct
entities.title: A loan product, with the GL accounts its invoices and disbursements post to (OFB-05, OFB-06)

entities.name: LoanLegacyRecon
entities.title: The reconciliation of one legacy loan in a migration run (FE 9.2 LEG-02 to LEG-05; outcomes MIG)

entities.name: LoanLegacyLine
entities.title: A line of a legacy loan's schedule as the legacy wrote it (version 0, FE 9.2 LEG-02)

services.name: quoteLoanSchedule
services.description: The schedule of proposed terms; nothing is stored (OFB-01).

services.name: discloseLoan
services.description: The disclosure of proposed terms (amount financed, finance charge, total of payments, APR); nothing is stored (OFB-01).

services.name: documentLoanSchedule
services.description: The schedule document of proposed terms (the printed schedule's lines and totals); nothing is stored.

services.name: bookLoan
services.description: Books a loan (OFB-02); idempotent by its external id (IDEM-01).

services.name: disburseLoan
services.description: Disburses a booked loan (OFB-04, OFB-06), with its down payment's invoice.

services.name: billDueLoanInstallments
services.description: Bills every installment due on or before the date and not billed yet, one invoice each (OFB-05, OFB-08).

services.name: recordLoanInvoiceStatus
services.description: An invoice changed status; for a loan invoice that became paid, or stopped being paid, the principal is collected or that collection cancelled (OFB-07).

attributes.name: description
attributes.value: A loan an earlier scenario left (tests only)

snippets.title: A Java service: DispatchContext, the user login and ServiceUtil

migration.description: Migrates a legacy loan book (its five datasets in bookDir, each named datasetPrefix + its name): every loan reconciled by the engine (LegacyMigration), its reconciliation and its legacy schedule lines (version 0) stored, and the loans that reconcile (MATCH, or D-2 where the service's schedule is the right one) booked through servicing. All or nothing: a DIFF rolls the run back. Idempotent by migrationId.

export.description: The shadow run's export (FE 9.3): the loans booked on a date as the legacy job's input, one folder per calculation with the requests, the run control, the legacy currency file and the map from the legacy ids to the loans.
